blockHints.HERO: A big picture with a heading and a button
blockHints.GALLERY: A grid of photos with captions
blockHints.CARDS: Boxes with a picture, text and a link
blockHints.CTA: A coloured band with one button
blockHints.CONTACT: Address, phone, email and a map
blockHints.NOTICES: Published notices for the whole school

pages.heading: Website
pages.subtitle: Your institution's public site: build pages from blocks, preview, then publish.
pages.title: Title
pages.seoTitleHint: What search engines show as the link (up to 70 letters).
pages.seoDescriptionHint: {{count}}/160 — the line under the link in search results.
pages.previewHint: This is the draft as it stands on your screen, including changes not yet saved. Links don't open in the preview.
pages.unpublishHint: The draft stays here; publish again whenever you like.
pages.unpublished: The page is off the site
pages.deleteHint: The page and its draft are removed. Pictures stay in the library.
pages.noBlocks: This page is empty. Add a block below.
pages.siteOff: The website is switched off: visitors to {{url}} see “not available”. Switch it on in Site settings once the home page is published.

blocks.heading: Heading
blocks.linkHint: Another page (/about), a web address (https://…), mailto: or tel:
blocks.applyLink: Button opens the online admission form
blocks.bodyHint: A blank line starts a new paragraph. ## Heading, - bullet, **bold**, *italic*, [link text](https://…).
blocks.caption: Caption
blocks.galleryHint: Up to {{max}} pictures. Each is made smaller before it is uploaded.
blocks.mapHint: Find your campus on openstreetmap.org, right-click it and choose “Show address” to copy the latitude and longitude.
blocks.noticesHint: Shows notices published in the Communication hub for the whole school (not those for some classes or students), newest first, until they expire. Notices have no separate “public” switch yet, so publish only what you are happy for anyone to read.
blocks.eventsHint: Shows published calendar events for everyone (not staff-only or class events), soonest first.
blocks.addSubtitle: Blocks appear on the page in this order; move them with the arrows.

images.tooLarge: This picture is too large even after shrinking it. Try a smaller photo.
images.deleteHint: The picture is removed from the website's picture library. A picture still used on a page can't be deleted — take it off that page first.

settings.title: Site settings
settings.liveHint: When on, published pages are open to everyone. Needs the publish permission.
settings.contactHint: Leave empty to use the institution profile's phone, email and address.
